summary: The `RptMnuFixedTermAppointments` user control in the HSPnet application is responsible for generating reports of fixed-term appointments. It utilizes a variety of UI controls and validators to ensure proper user input and provides the ability to export data to Excel.
purpose: To facilitate the generation and export of reports on fixed-term appointments within the HSPnet application environment.

workflows.name: Generate Fixed Term Appointment Report
steps: User navigates to the RptMnuFixedTermAppointments control.
User inputs start and end dates for the report using txtStartDate and txtEndDate fields.
User clicks the button to run the report.
The system validates the input dates using RegularExpressionValidators and RequiredFieldValidators.
If valid, the system calls the stored procedure 'ReportFixedTermAppointments' with the provided date range.
The system generates and displays the report.
User can export the report to Excel by clicking the Excel export button.

business_rules: Stored procedure 'ReportFixedTermAppointments' must be executed to fetch the report data.
validations: Date fields (Start and End dates) must be validated for correct format using RegularExpressionValidators.
Both Start and End dates are mandatory fields, enforced by RequiredFieldValidators.
conditions: The report generation is contingent on valid date inputs.
system_behavior: Renders UI components for report options and descriptions.
Registers and executes JavaScript for date fields and validation.
Fetches report data based on user session and date parameters.
Displays report in HTML format on the UI if data is retrieved successfully.
exceptions: Invalid dates input will prevent report generation.
Empty reportHTML will not display a report.
